patch_description: Replace the mostly random-restart optimization with a systematic grid over structured two-ring families (staggered k1+k2 rings at varying heights/twists, placed on the unit sphere), refine each with the existing soft-min/soft-max ascent, then add an exact "hard pair" polish that directly pushes apart the currently-closest pair and pulls together the currently-farthest pair. The best-known 14-point spherical configurations resemble staggered rings, and the hard subgradient polish attacks the true objective (dmin/dmax) instead of only a soft surrogate, which should push the squared ratio toward the reference 1/4.1658 ≈ 0.24.
